text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking and discussing 
plans with Mejiro Ramonu...

O Witch of Toriko... cast your magic 
already! I'll definitely memorize it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like our conversation is over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Lacking focus. I simply cannot bear to 
listen to someone in that state.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell—
Aah! Where do you think you're going?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why aren't you casting your magic?! 
Show it to me already!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! I came to catch the 
decisive moment when Ramonu uses her 
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! It has to be!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
âRamonu is using magic to captivate 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whenever someone talks with Ramonu, the 
look in their eyes completely changes... 
they go crazy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely using love magic! And a 
powerful... dark incantation at that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So, Ramonu! Teach me to—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh!? Ramonu isn't here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While Sweep Tosho was absorbed in 
talking, Mejiro Ramonu had already slipped 
away, giving me nothing more than a 
passing glance."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez~~, if you're her Trainer, don't just 
let her do whatever she wants!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to be emotionally 
wounded!? Let's chase after them!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ramonu! Teach me a spell right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ... Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that single sentence, I could feel the 
silent pressure asking, "I thought I left 
this to you?"...
choice_data_list: They said they want to see your magic...

They said they really want to see your 
magic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it's about my magic... this person 
knows all about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please explain it to them.
choice_data_list: (She totally dumped it all on me!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What, if you knew, you should have told me 
earlier! So, what kind of magic is it?!
choice_data_list: Just let the magic enchant you and learn.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Speed?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The greatest magic Mejiro Ramonu 
possesses... the thing that captivates 
people the most is, without a doubt, her 
running. And among all her qualities, her 
speed is truly beautiful.
choice_data_list:
For example, during a certain training 
session—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So, I spoke about Mejiro Ramonu's 
mesmerizing running up to this point. I 
thought Sweep Tosho would understand once 
she learned of its charm, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...That's just gross!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The way you talk is way too passionate, 
it's scary! You're... don't tell me you've 
already fallen completely under their 
spell?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Forget it! I don't need your spells, 
Ramonu! Sorry for bothering you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How pitiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu gave me a rare word of 
appreciation... but for a while after, all 
that echoed in my head was 'that's kinda 
gross.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ramonu's magic...?
choice_data_list:
Learning by doing is the best way, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean... I'm gonna be 
completely captivated by Ramonu?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Do you wish to be captivated by 
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall remake you, heart and 
soul...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...! N-No, no way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I am NOT going crazzyyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey... You're a bad person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Really? Guess that makes us accomplices, 
huh...
